subject: planner: Enable non-prepared plan cache for queries with hints. (#60952)
summary: Reviewed the planner-only changes enabling non-prepared plan cache for SELECTs with optimizer hints (via allowing `*ast.TableOptimizerHint` and updating cache-skip gating).
